name: Trigger All Workflows
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  trigger-all:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Trigger bioservices workflows
        run: |
          gh workflow run ci.yml -r main
          gh workflow run geo.yml -r main
          gh workflow run proteins.yml -r main
          gh workflow run string.yml -r main
          gh workflow run notebooks.yml -r main
          # Trigger the remaining 38 service workflows
          for i in {1..38}; do
            gh workflow run service-${i}.yml -r main
          done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Trigger All Workflows
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  trigger-all:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Trigger bioservices workflows
        run: |
          gh workflow run ci.yml -r main
          gh workflow run geo.yml -r main
          gh workflow run proteins.yml -r main
          gh workflow run string.yml -r main
          gh workflow run notebooks.yml -r main
          # Trigger the remaining 38 service workflows
          for i in {1..38}; do
            gh workflow run service-${i}.yml -r main
          done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
